name: K925

origin.basis: Kenda Rubber Industrial Co. won a 2017 Taiwan Excellence award for the Valkyrie (K1160X).

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory.

positioning: Kenda's 120 TPI folding road race clincher sold in mainland China under the K925 code.
weight_basis: The shop listing gives no weights.

wet_notes.summary: A K925 25C owner lists being rather slippery on wet roads as one of its known weaknesses.

community.summary: A commenter blames poor shoulder grip for their only crash; conditions not stated.

availability.note: Sold by Taobao shops in mainland China; other regions not verified.

price_observations.conditions: Shop list price before discounts on 2026-11-01 for the folding 700x25 option; coupon price CNY 111.24. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: An owner reports it is rather slippery on wet roads, and another blames its shoulder grip for a crash; no lab test found.
The listing does not say whether a price is for one tire or a pair.
TPI and pressure come from shop option labels; weights are not published.
A non-folding 700x25 version is also sold.

image.shown: K925 tires in their retail boxes, labelled Kaliente, 700x28C K925, folding bead, 120 TPI, in an owner's post.
image.alt: Kenda K925 Kaliente road tires in labelled retail boxes

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model and, where the model is sold in more than one construction, say which; seller replies, questions, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. One owner's report that it is slippery in the wet is a single wet report.

reports.summary: Rides the 25 mm and bought more: low rolling resistance and good road feel, but not very puncture resistant and fairly slippery when wet.
Narrower than a Continental GSR, rolls easily and is easy to fit.
Good road feel and cheap; puncture protection is acceptable, but it needs replacing at about 5,000 km for a light rider.
No flat in over a year on a touring bike and easy to fit, but the bead area cracks easily.
In an uncontrolled four-tire comparison it tied for the lowest rolling resistance but had the least grip; the owner liked riding it.

checks.note: Three posts; one owner posted twice
